query: SELECT DISTINCT t.name FROM taggings g JOIN tags t ON t.pid = g.tag_pid WHERE ((g.subject_kind = 'contact' AND (g.subject_pid = $1 OR g.subject_pid IN (SELECT pid FROM contacts WHERE merged_into_pid = $1))) OR (g.subject_kind = 'lead' AND g.subject_pid IN (SELECT pid FROM leads WHERE contact_pid = $1))) /* whatever deleted_at holds: a merged duplicate and a lead are the subject's */ ORDER BY t.name
